PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focus with Subacromial Impingement Adaptations"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength with impingement-friendly protocol"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and Pain-free Load Foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and Pain-free Load Foundation II":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and Pain-free Load Foundation III":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression and Pain-free Load Foundation IV":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x12
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Controlled Strength Build - Horizontal Push/Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability + Load Increase":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability plus Scapular Control":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength Maintenance + Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Load Progression with Pain‑Free Cues":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume Increase and Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Subacromial Friendly Accessory Mix":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Test & Transition to Next Phase":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

EXERCISE VOCABULARY USAGE NOTES:
- All exercises listed in allowed vocabulary only.
- Avoid overhead loading; where pressing is included, use stable, pain-free ranges (incline/bench, not overhead).
- Default to horizontal pushing/pulling and supported rows; avoid overhead press variants.

CARDIO MODALITIES (warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions):
- walking
- cycling

ADAPTATION GUIDANCE:
- Prioritize pain-free ROM; stop any set if sharp pain or catching occurs.
- Use RPE targets to manage load; if RPE > 7 or form breaks, reduce load or revert to prior week’s reps.
- Incorporate scapular stability cues on pulling exercises (pin shoulder blades, retract during concentric, protract during eccentric).
- Progression: increase reps within target range before adding load; stay within pain-free range.

NOTES:
- This plan provides 12 weeks of upper-body focused training with progressive overload while respecting subacromial impingement constraints.
- If any day needs adjustment due to access to equipment or time, substitute with equivalent horizontal push/pull movement from allowed vocabulary.
